analysis_population.contacts: Only C3-admissible Nott microglia promoter-distal contact pairs.
analysis_population.paired_structure: The exact same retained contact pairs are evaluated against PU1/microglia, NeuN/neuron and Olig2/oligodendrocyte accessibility.

binary_accessibility_support.rule: A distal anchor is supported in a cell-type ATAC track if its hg38 interval has >=1 bp overlap with at least one authenticated ATAC peak interval in that track.
binary_accessibility_support.why: This is literal set intersection and introduces no fractional-overlap or center-distance threshold to tune.
binary_accessibility_support.multiple_peaks: Still one supported contact pair; peak multiplicity is not counted as extra support.
binary_accessibility_support.promoter_anchor_accessibility: Not part of the primary binary support statistic; the contact assay is promoter-anchored by construction and the P1S question is distal substrate compatibility.

effect_reporting: absolute support rate in each cell type
number of microglia-only, comparator-only, both-supported and neither-supported pairs

uncertainty.method: nonparametric cluster bootstrap over promoter identity
uncertainty.reason: Multiple distal contacts from the same promoter are not independent.

primary_paired_cell_type_contrasts.pass_requirement: The lower bound of the 95% promoter-cluster-bootstrap interval must be > 0 for BOTH microglia-neuron and microglia-oligodendrocyte paired differences.
primary_paired_cell_type_contrasts.hard_stop: If either lower bound is <= 0, classify NOT_MICROGLIA_FIT_FOR_TARGET_CONSTRUCTION under P1S.

promoter_fixed_exact_distance_null.purpose: Test whether observed microglia distal accessibility exceeds genomic opportunity under promoter-fixed contact geometry.
construction: For each observed contact pair, preserve its exact absolute promoter-distal midpoint distance and distal interval length.
Generate the null distal interval on the opposite genomic side of the promoter midpoint when that interval remains fully within the same chromosome.
If the opposite-side interval is invalid/out of chromosome bounds, mark that pair NULL_NOT_CONSTRUCTIBLE for this exact-distance null; do not substitute a different distance.
Promoter degree is preserved exactly because every constructible observed edge contributes at most one null edge.
promoter_fixed_exact_distance_null.why_no_random_tournament: The opposite-side construction gives an outcome-blind deterministic exact-distance counterfactual and avoids choosing a Monte Carlo replicate count after seeing null variability.
promoter_fixed_exact_distance_null.primary_null_statistic: Among pairs with a constructible exact-distance opposite-side null, compare observed microglia distal-support binary value with its paired null-support binary value.

uncertainty.method: nonparametric cluster bootstrap over promoter identity on observed-minus-null paired differences

promoter_fixed_exact_distance_null.pass_requirement: Lower 95% promoter-cluster-bootstrap bound for observed-minus-null support must be > 0.
reporting: NULL_NOT_CONSTRUCTIBLE count and fraction from the C3-admissible denominator
promoter_fixed_exact_distance_null.limitations: This null preserves promoter identity, exact distance, chromosome, distal width and promoter degree, but does not guarantee matched local regulatory density. Local-density sensitivity must therefore be reported separately rather than claimed as exactly preserved.

required_descriptive_strata: local ATAC peak density around distal anchor
nuisance_and_geometry_reporting.rule: Report support contrasts across predeclared quartiles of distance, degree and local peak density as sensitivity/descriptive checks. Do not use those strata to redefine the primary population after seeing results.
nuisance_and_geometry_reporting.no_silent_import: Do not import the frozen NIH-CARD RNA/ATAC continuous-adjustment estimator into P1S.

P1S_PASS: Both same-pair microglia-vs-neuron and microglia-vs-oligodendrocyte lower 95% promoter-cluster-bootstrap bounds are >0, AND the observed-vs-exact-distance-null lower bound is >0.
claim_scope: A P1S pass establishes internal microglial substrate compatibility of the Nott-centered contact object within this same-study comparator system. It does not establish independent external replication, donor-independent corroboration, multi-source contact replication or causal enhancer-gene assignment.
